### Estetika dan Falsafah Seni

Groups: 3 · Skills: 11

[aestheticsAndPhilosophyOfArt.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/aestheticsAndPhilosophyOfArt/aestheticsAndPhilosophyOfArt.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Aesthetic inquiry asks why experiences, works, and environments are judged beautiful, expressive, meaningful, or artistically valuable. Its focus is justification and concepts of value, not techniques of making art.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Terokai mengapa orang menganggap pengalaman dan karya seni indah atau bernilai.

#### Pertimbangan Estetika

Skills: 4

[aestheticJudgment.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/aestheticsAndPhilosophyOfArt/aestheticJudgment/aestheticJudgment.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** An aesthetic evaluation can invoke perceptual qualities, interpretation, tradition, or standards that other observers may dispute.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Ketahui bagaimana pendapat estetika boleh disokong dengan alasan.

##### Menganalisis peranan konteks dalam pengalaman estetika

[analyzeTheRoleOfContextInAestheticExperience.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/aestheticsAndPhilosophyOfArt/aestheticJudgment/skills/analyzeTheRoleOfContextInAestheticExperience.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how setting, background knowledge, and cultural conventions can alter interpretation while the object remains unchanged.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Terokai bagaimana konteks atau pengetahuan latar mengubah pengalaman estetika.

##### Membandingkan pandangan objektif dan subjektif tentang keindahan

[compareObjectiveAndSubjectiveAccountsOfBeauty.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/aestheticsAndPhilosophyOfArt/aestheticJudgment/skills/compareObjectiveAndSubjectiveAccountsOfBeauty.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine whether aesthetic assessments can be reasoned about beyond individual preference without assuming universal consensus.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Bandingkan pandangan sama ada keindahan boleh dinilai melebihi cita rasa peribadi.

##### Membezakan nilai estetika dan nilai kegunaan

[distinguishAestheticFromInstrumentalValue.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/aestheticsAndPhilosophyOfArt/aestheticJudgment/skills/distinguishAestheticFromInstrumentalValue.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain why something may be appreciated for its appearance or experience rather than its practical usefulness.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Bezakan keindahan atau nilai ekspresif benda daripada kegunaan praktikalnya.

##### Mewajarkan pertimbangan estetika

[justifyAnAestheticJudgment.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/aestheticsAndPhilosophyOfArt/aestheticJudgment/skills/justifyAnAestheticJudgment.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Support an appraisal with relevant features and criteria rather than simply reporting that one likes or dislikes an object.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Terangkan penilaian estetika menggunakan ciri relevan, bukan cita rasa sendiri semata-mata.

#### Seni dan Tafsiran

Skills: 4

[artAndInterpretation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/aestheticsAndPhilosophyOfArt/artAndInterpretation/artAndInterpretation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A work can bear meanings and values that are not reducible to the creator's stated intent or a viewer's immediate reaction.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Pertimbangkan bagaimana karya seni boleh membawa makna melebihi niat penciptanya.

##### Menganalisis penilaian etika terhadap seni

[analyzeTheEthicalEvaluationOfArt.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/aestheticsAndPhilosophyOfArt/artAndInterpretation/skills/analyzeTheEthicalEvaluationOfArt.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explore whether and how moral concerns about content, production, or reception bear on artistic appraisal.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Teliti sama ada persoalan moral patut mempengaruhi pertimbangan seni.

##### Membandingkan tafsiran karya seni

[compareInterpretationsOfAnArtwork.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/aestheticsAndPhilosophyOfArt/artAndInterpretation/skills/compareInterpretationsOfAnArtwork.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate rival readings by their attention to the work's features and context rather than assuming every reading is equally supported.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Bandingkan tafsiran berdasarkan bukti daripada ciri dan sejarah karya.

##### Membezakan niat seniman dan tafsiran

[distinguishArtisticIntentionFromInterpretation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/aestheticsAndPhilosophyOfArt/artAndInterpretation/skills/distinguishArtisticIntentionFromInterpretation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess what a creator reportedly intended separately from meanings supported by the work and its reception.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Asingkan maksud seniman daripada tafsiran yang disokong oleh karya itu sendiri.

##### Menilai takrif seni

[evaluateADefinitionOfArt.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/aestheticsAndPhilosophyOfArt/artAndInterpretation/skills/evaluateADefinitionOfArt.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Test a proposed criterion against borderline cases, changing practices, and works that challenge established categories.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Uji takrif seni dengan contoh luar biasa atau sukar dikelaskan.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Terokai bagaimana tradisi seni berbeza mempunyai ukuran nilai yang bermakna.

##### Membezakan cita rasa dan penilaian beralasan

[distinguishTasteFromAnArguedEvaluation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/aestheticsAndPhilosophyOfArt/valueAndTaste/skills/distinguishTasteFromAnArguedEvaluation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize that a personal reaction and a defensible public judgment may overlap but require different kinds of support.

[evaluateTheRoleOfExpertiseInAestheticJudgment.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/aestheticsAndPhilosophyOfArt/valueAndTaste/skills/evaluateTheRoleOfExpertiseInAestheticJudgment.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Consider how practiced perception and historical knowledge may inform an assessment without making expert preferences infallible.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Pertimbangkan bagaimana kepakaran membantu penilaian tanpa menjadikan pakar sentiasa betul.

### Epistemologi dan penilaian kritis

Groups: 4 · Skills: 19

[epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Questions about knowledge concern what can be believed responsibly, what makes claims true, and when confidence should change. This domain applies general standards of justification to testimony and public information; scientific experimental design has its own domain.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Terokai perkara yang menjadikan sesuatu kepercayaan berasas dan cara menilai maklumat awam.

#### Bukti dan kesaksian

Skills: 5

[evidenceAndTestimony.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/evidenceAndTestimony/evidenceAndTestimony.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Knowledge often depends on information supplied by other people or institutions. Source reliability, independence, and evidential fit require appraisal without treating every source as equally trustworthy.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Pelajari cara menilai dakwaan dan bukti yang disampaikan oleh orang lain.

##### Menganalisis ketidakadilan epistemik

[analyzeEpistemicInjustice.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/evidenceAndTestimony/skills/analyzeEpistemicInjustice.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine how prejudicial credibility judgments or unequal interpretive resources can wrong someone in their capacity as a knower, distinct from warranted critical assessment of testimony.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Terokai bagaimana penilaian kredibiliti yang tidak adil boleh menyebabkan orang tidak didengari.

##### Memeriksa pengesahan antara sumber

[checkCorroborationAcrossSources.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/evidenceAndTestimony/skills/checkCorroborationAcrossSources.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine whether apparently agreeing accounts are genuinely independent or reproduce one underlying report.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Semak sama ada beberapa sumber yang sependapat benar-benar memberikan bukti bebas.

##### Membezakan dakwaan daripada buktinya

[distinguishAClaimFromItsEvidence.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/evidenceAndTestimony/skills/distinguishAClaimFromItsEvidence.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Separate what someone asserts from the observations, documents, or arguments presented to support it.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Asingkan pernyataan daripada bukti yang digunakan untuk menyokongnya.

##### Membezakan bukti langsung daripada keterangan dengar cakap

[distinguishDirectEvidenceFromHearsay.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/evidenceAndTestimony/skills/distinguishDirectEvidenceFromHearsay.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize what a record or witness directly establishes and what depends on another person's retelling.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Bezakan rekod secara langsung daripada dakwaan yang diulang oleh orang lain.

##### Menilai kebolehpercayaan kesaksian

[evaluateTestimonialCredibility.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/evidenceAndTestimony/skills/evaluateTestimonialCredibility.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Consider the speaker's opportunity to know, relevant competence, track record, and possible conflicts without reducing evaluation to popularity.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Nilai saksi atau pakar berdasarkan pengalaman berkaitan dan kemungkinan konflik kepentingan.

#### Pengetahuan dan justifikasi

Skills: 5

[knowledgeAndJustification.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/knowledgeAndJustification/knowledgeAndJustification.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Belief, truth, evidence, and knowledge have distinct roles in epistemic evaluation. Competing theories of knowledge can disagree about exactly how those roles connect.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Ketahui bagaimana kepercayaan, kebenaran, bukti dan pengetahuan saling berkait tetapi berbeza.

##### Menganalisis pembuktian matematik sebagai justifikasi

[analyzeMathematicalProofAsJustification.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/knowledgeAndJustification/skills/analyzeMathematicalProofAsJustification.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine why deductive proof has a distinctive epistemic role in mathematics, distinguishing formal derivability from experimental confirmation and acknowledging debates about proof's explanatory value.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Terokai sebab pembuktian matematik berbeza daripada bukti yang diperoleh melalui eksperimen.

##### Membandingkan justifikasi a priori dan empirikal

[compareAPrioriAndEmpiricalJustification.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/knowledgeAndJustification/skills/compareAPrioriAndEmpiricalJustification.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish support based primarily on reasoning from support requiring experience, without assuming the boundary is universally uncontested.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Bandingkan pengetahuan berasaskan penaakulan dengan pengetahuan berasaskan pengalaman.

##### Membezakan kepercayaan dengan pengetahuan

[distinguishBeliefFromKnowledge.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/knowledgeAndJustification/skills/distinguishBeliefFromKnowledge.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize that sincerely accepting a proposition does not by itself establish that it is known, even when the speaker is confident.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Fahami mengapa benar-benar mempercayai sesuatu dakwaan tidak semestinya bermakna mengetahuinya.

##### Membezakan kebenaran dengan justifikasi

[distinguishTruthFromJustification.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/knowledgeAndJustification/skills/distinguishTruthFromJustification.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain why a claim might be true for reasons its holder cannot supply, or well supported yet ultimately false.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Bezakan dakwaan yang benar dengan adanya alasan kukuh untuk mempercayainya.

##### Menilai alasan bagi sesuatu kepercayaan

[evaluateReasonsForABelief.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/knowledgeAndJustification/skills/evaluateReasonsForABelief.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine whether offered grounds actually bear on the proposition and withstand plausible objections.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Semak sama ada alasan yang diberikan benar-benar menyokong sesuatu kepercayaan.

#### Media dan maklumat awam

Skills: 5

[mediaAndPublicInformation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/mediaAndPublicInformation/mediaAndPublicInformation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Information environments combine reporting, interpretation, promotion, and falsehood. Epistemic evaluation concerns the warrant for public claims, not the psychological mechanics by which messages persuade audiences.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Pelajari cara menyiasat laporan berita, pendapat dan dakwaan yang dikongsi secara terbuka.

[distinguishMisinformationFromDeliberateDeceptionClaims.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/mediaAndPublicInformation/skills/distinguishMisinformationFromDeliberateDeceptionClaims.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify inaccurate information without asserting an author's intention to deceive unless independent evidence supports that inference.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Kenal pasti dakwaan tidak tepat tanpa menganggap penuturnya berniat menipu.

##### Membezakan laporan daripada pendapat

[distinguishReportingFromOpinion.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/mediaAndPublicInformation/skills/distinguishReportingFromOpinion.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify whether a passage presents checkable occurrences, interpretation, advocacy, or a mixture requiring separate evaluation.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Bezakan laporan fakta daripada tafsiran dan sokongan terhadap sesuatu pendirian.

[evaluateEvidenceBehindAHeadline.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/mediaAndPublicInformation/skills/evaluateEvidenceBehindAHeadline.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compare a summary with the underlying article or evidence and identify claims that exceed what is documented.

[recognizeMisleadingContextInPresentedEvidence.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/mediaAndPublicInformation/skills/recognizeMisleadingContextInPresentedEvidence.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Detect how cropping, omitted baselines, selective examples, or missing dates can alter the apparent meaning of otherwise genuine material.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Lihat cara tarikh yang dibuang, imej yang dipangkas atau konteks yang hilang boleh mengelirukan.

[traceAPublicClaimToItsOriginalSource.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/mediaAndPublicInformation/skills/traceAPublicClaimToItsOriginalSource.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Follow citations or reposts to determine what a primary document, recording, or dataset actually says.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Jejaki dakwaan kepada dokumen atau rakaman asal untuk melihat apa yang benar-benar dinyatakan.

#### Ketidakpastian dan skeptisisme

Skills: 4

[uncertaintyAndSkepticism.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/uncertaintyAndSkepticism/uncertaintyAndSkepticism.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Rational inquiry must accommodate incomplete evidence and the possibility of error without collapsing into indiscriminate doubt.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Ketahui cara berfikir secara bertanggungjawab apabila bukti tidak lengkap.

[calibrateConfidenceToEvidence.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/uncertaintyAndSkepticism/skills/calibrateConfidenceToEvidence.data.ts)

[identifyADisagreementAboutEvidenceStandards.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/uncertaintyAndSkepticism/skills/identifyADisagreementAboutEvidenceStandards.data.ts)

[recognizeTheLimitsOfPersonalKnowledge.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/uncertaintyAndSkepticism/skills/recognizeTheLimitsOfPersonalKnowledge.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Differentiate what one has observed, inferred, learned from others, or cannot currently establish.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Bezakan perkara yang anda perhatikan sendiri daripada perkara yang hanya anda simpulkan.

### Etika dan penaakulan moral

Groups: 5 · Skills: 25

[ethicsAndMoralReasoning.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/ethicsAndMoralReasoning/ethicsAndMoralReasoning.data.ts)

Skills: 5

[appliedEthics.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/ethicsAndMoralReasoning/appliedEthics/appliedEthics.data.ts)

[evaluateConsentInAnEthicalScenario.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/ethicsAndMoralReasoning/appliedEthics/skills/evaluateConsentInAnEthicalScenario.data.ts)

[evaluatePrivacyAsAnEthicalValue.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/ethicsAndMoralReasoning/appliedEthics/skills/evaluatePrivacyAsAnEthicalValue.data.ts)

Skills: 5

[ethicalFrameworks.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/ethicsAndMoralReasoning/ethicalFrameworks/ethicalFrameworks.data.ts)

[applyCareEthicalReasoning.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/ethicsAndMoralReasoning/ethicalFrameworks/skills/applyCareEthicalReasoning.data.ts)

[applyConsequentialistReasoning.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/ethicsAndMoralReasoning/ethicalFrameworks/skills/applyConsequentialistReasoning.data.ts)

[applyDutyBasedReasoning.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/ethicsAndMoralReasoning/ethicalFrameworks/skills/applyDutyBasedReasoning.data.ts)

[applyVirtueEthicalReasoning.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/ethicsAndMoralReasoning/ethicalFrameworks/skills/applyVirtueEthicalReasoning.data.ts)

[compareEthicalFrameworksOnOneDilemma.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/ethicsAndMoralReasoning/ethicalFrameworks/skills/compareEthicalFrameworksOnOneDilemma.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain why distinct normative standards may support different recommendations even when the underlying facts are shared.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Bandingkan cara teori moral berbeza membuat kesimpulan tentang dilema yang sama.

#### Metaetika

Skills: 6

[metaethics.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/ethicsAndMoralReasoning/metaethics/metaethics.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Inquiry into the meaning, objectivity, and epistemic standing of moral discourse underlies but does not itself prescribe codes of conduct. Normative theories decide how to act; metaethical theories examine the status of such judgments.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Terokai makna dakwaan moral dan sama ada kebenaran moral bergantung pada kepercayaan peribadi.

##### Menganalisis perselisihan moral

[analyzeMoralDisagreement.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/ethicsAndMoralReasoning/metaethics/skills/analyzeMoralDisagreement.data.ts)

**User-friendly description (ms):** Bezakan perselisihan tentang fakta daripada perselisihan tentang piawaian moral.

##### Membandingkan realisme moral dan antirealisme

[compareMoralRealismAndAntiRealism.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/ethicsAndMoralReasoning/metaethics/skills/compareMoralRealismAndAntiRealism.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess opposing views about whether moral truths exist independently of attitudes, and distinguish this ontological disagreement from practical moral choices.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Bandingkan pandangan yang menerima kebenaran moral objektif dengan yang menolaknya.

##### Membezakan soalan metaetika daripada normatif

[distinguishMetaethicalFromNormativeQuestions.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/ethicsAndMoralReasoning/metaethics/skills/distinguishMetaethicalFromNormativeQuestions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Separate questions about which actions are right from questions about what moral claims mean and whether their truth is objective.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Bezakan soalan tentang apa yang betul dengan soalan tentang maksud pertimbangan moral.

##### Membezakan kognitivisme moral daripada bukan kognitivisme

[distinguishMoralCognitivismFromNonCognitivism.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/ethicsAndMoralReasoning/metaethics/skills/distinguishMoralCognitivismFromNonCognitivism.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine whether moral utterances express truth-apt beliefs or instead function as prescriptions, commitments, or other attitudes.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Terokai sama ada ayat moral menyatakan fakta atau meluahkan sikap dan komitmen.

[evaluateMoralRelativism.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/ethicsAndMoralReasoning/metaethics/skills/evaluateMoralRelativism.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Test the view that moral truth or justification varies by culture or individual against cases involving disagreement, criticism, and reform.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Teliti sama ada betul dan salah bergantung pada budaya atau perspektif individu.

##### Meneliti motivasi moral

[examineMoralMotivation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/ethicsAndMoralReasoning/metaethics/skills/examineMoralMotivation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compare philosophical positions on whether sincerely judging an act right necessarily motivates someone to perform it, without substituting a psychological causal theory.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Pertimbangkan sama ada mempercayai sesuatu itu betul semestinya mendorong tindakan.

[moralConcepts.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/ethicsAndMoralReasoning/moralConcepts/moralConcepts.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify what it means to hold that a person is obligated to act even when doing so is inconvenient.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Fahami mengapa kewajipan moral mungkin tetap terpakai walaupun sukar dipenuhi.

##### Membezakan niat daripada akibat

[distinguishIntentionsFromConsequences.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/ethicsAndMoralReasoning/moralConcepts/skills/distinguishIntentionsFromConsequences.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain why an action's aim and its actual effects may be evaluated separately in moral reasoning.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Nilai tujuan yang diniatkan dan kesan sesuatu tindakan secara berasingan.

##### Membezakan penilaian moral dan bukan moral

[distinguishMoralFromNonMoralJudgments.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/ethicsAndMoralReasoning/moralConcepts/skills/distinguishMoralFromNonMoralJudgments.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify when a claim concerns obligations or rights rather than taste, etiquette, prudence, or mere legality.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Bezakan dakwaan etika daripada cita rasa peribadi, adab dan peraturan undang-undang.

[distinguishMoralResponsibilityFromCausalResponsibility.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/ethicsAndMoralReasoning/moralConcepts/skills/distinguishMoralResponsibilityFromCausalResponsibility.data.ts)

**User-friendly description (ms):** Bezakan menjadi punca sesuatu daripada wajar dipersalahkan dari segi moral.

#### Pertimbangan moral

Skills: 5

[moralDeliberation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/ethicsAndMoralReasoning/moralDeliberation/moralDeliberation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Difficult cases require identifying who is affected, which reasons conflict, and whether an apparent compromise respects relevant obligations.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Belajar menaakul pilihan sukar apabila pertimbangan etika bercanggah.

[assessProportionalityInMoralDecisions.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/ethicsAndMoralReasoning/moralDeliberation/skills/assessProportionalityInMoralDecisions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Consider whether a harmful burden or restriction is justified in relation to its aim and less harmful alternatives.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Nilai sama ada mudarat atau sekatan setimpal dengan matlamat yang wajar.

##### Menilai hujah balas moral

[evaluateAMoralCounterargument.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/ethicsAndMoralReasoning/moralDeliberation/skills/evaluateAMoralCounterargument.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Test whether an objection exposes an overlooked harm, inconsistency, or relevant exception to a principle.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Pertimbangkan bantahan yang menunjukkan mudarat, pengecualian atau percanggahan.

##### Mengenal pasti kewajipan moral yang bercanggah

[identifyConflictingMoralObligations.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/ethicsAndMoralReasoning/moralDeliberation/skills/identifyConflictingMoralObligations.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Specify duties or values that cannot all be fully honored in a concrete case without assuming that all conflicts are irresolvable.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Kenal pasti keadaan apabila dua kewajipan etika tidak dapat dipenuhi sepenuhnya serentak.

[identifyStakeholdersInAnEthicalDilemma.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/ethicsAndMoralReasoning/moralDeliberation/skills/identifyStakeholdersInAnEthicalDilemma.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize persons or other morally relevant parties affected directly or indirectly by a proposed choice.

##### Mewajarkan pertimbangan moral

[justifyAMoralJudgment.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/ethicsAndMoralReasoning/moralDeliberation/skills/justifyAMoralJudgment.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Connect a normative conclusion to stated values, principles, and case facts rather than mere personal preference.

### Sejarah dan Tradisi Falsafah

Groups: 3 · Skills: 15

[historyAndTraditionsOfPhilosophy.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/historyAndTraditionsOfPhilosophy/historyAndTraditionsOfPhilosophy.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Historically situated philosophical arguments develop through schools, intellectual movements, and traditions across cultures. Interpretation requires understanding both what a thinker argued and the debate that shaped the argument, without privileging one lineage as philosophy's default.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Terokai idea falsafah pelbagai budaya dan zaman melalui hujahnya.

#### Tradisi Falsafah

Skills: 8

[philosophicalTraditions.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/historyAndTraditionsOfPhilosophy/philosophicalTraditions/philosophicalTraditions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Intellectual traditions developed across many cultures through original arguments and sustained exchanges. Greek, Indian, Chinese, Islamic, African, Latin American, and particular Indigenous lineages are examined as philosophical sources in their own right, without treating a region as a single doctrine.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Teliti hujah falsafah yang berkembang dalam pelbagai tradisi budaya.

##### Menganalisis hujah falsafah tradisi Cina

[analyzeAPhilosophicalArgumentFromAChineseTradition.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/historyAndTraditionsOfPhilosophy/philosophicalTraditions/skills/analyzeAPhilosophicalArgumentFromAChineseTradition.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret a position in a specific Chinese philosophical lineage, such as Confucian or Daoist thinking, without conflating them.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Tafsirkan dakwaan daripada tradisi Cina dalam konteksnya.

##### Menganalisis hujah tradisi Amerika Latin

[analyzeAPhilosophicalArgumentFromALatinAmericanTradition.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/historyAndTraditionsOfPhilosophy/philosophicalTraditions/skills/analyzeAPhilosophicalArgumentFromALatinAmericanTradition.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Reconstruct an argument from a specific Latin American current, such as liberation or decolonial philosophy, in its intellectual and social context without reducing the region to one doctrine.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Terokai hujah falsafah Amerika Latin dalam konteks sosial dan intelektualnya.

##### Menganalisis hujah tradisi Afrika

[analyzeAPhilosophicalArgumentFromAnAfricanTradition.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/historyAndTraditionsOfPhilosophy/philosophicalTraditions/skills/analyzeAPhilosophicalArgumentFromAnAfricanTradition.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine a representative argument concerning persons, community, knowledge, or values while avoiding claims that Africa has a single philosophy.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Analisis hujah falsafah daripada tradisi Afrika tertentu.

##### Menganalisis Hujah Tradisi Falsafah India

[analyzeAPhilosophicalArgumentFromAnIndianTradition.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/historyAndTraditionsOfPhilosophy/philosophicalTraditions/skills/analyzeAPhilosophicalArgumentFromAnIndianTradition.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify claims and reasons in a specific Indian philosophical school while preserving its distinctive terms and internal disagreements.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Terokai hujah daripada aliran falsafah India tertentu.

[analyzeAPhilosophicalArgumentFromAnIndigenousTradition.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/historyAndTraditionsOfPhilosophy/philosophicalTraditions/skills/analyzeAPhilosophicalArgumentFromAnIndigenousTradition.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret philosophical claims from a particular Indigenous people or intellectual tradition on their own conceptual terms, recognizing differences among communities and avoiding a generic 'Indigenous worldview'.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Fahami idea falsafah tradisi Orang Asal mengikut konteksnya.

##### Menganalisis Hujah Tradisi Falsafah Islam

[analyzeAPhilosophicalArgumentFromAnIslamicTradition.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/historyAndTraditionsOfPhilosophy/philosophicalTraditions/skills/analyzeAPhilosophicalArgumentFromAnIslamicTradition.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain a selected debate in Islamic philosophy using its intellectual context rather than assuming theology and philosophy are identical.

[compareClassicalGreekPhilosophicalApproaches.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/historyAndTraditionsOfPhilosophy/philosophicalTraditions/skills/compareClassicalGreekPhilosophicalApproaches.data.ts)

**User-friendly description (ms):** Bandingkan idea Socrates, Plato dan Aristotle.

[comparePositionsAcrossPhilosophicalTraditions.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/historyAndTraditionsOfPhilosophy/philosophicalTraditions/skills/comparePositionsAcrossPhilosophicalTraditions.data.ts)

**User-friendly description (ms):** Bandingkan cara tradisi berbeza menangani persoalan falsafah serupa.

[readingPhilosophicalWorks.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/historyAndTraditionsOfPhilosophy/readingPhilosophicalWorks/readingPhilosophicalWorks.data.ts)

[evaluateAPhilosophicalTextCritically.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/historyAndTraditionsOfPhilosophy/readingPhilosophicalWorks/skills/evaluateAPhilosophicalTextCritically.data.ts)

[identifyTheCentralProblemInAPhilosophicalText.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/historyAndTraditionsOfPhilosophy/readingPhilosophicalWorks/skills/identifyTheCentralProblemInAPhilosophicalText.data.ts)

[interpretAPhilosopherInHistoricalContext.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/historyAndTraditionsOfPhilosophy/readingPhilosophicalWorks/skills/interpretAPhilosopherInHistoricalContext.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use contemporaneous debates and available concepts to avoid attributing later assumptions to an earlier author.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Tafsir pandangan falsafah berdasarkan perbahasan pada zamannya.

[reconstructAHistoricalPhilosophicalArgument.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/historyAndTraditionsOfPhilosophy/readingPhilosophicalWorks/skills/reconstructAHistoricalPhilosophicalArgument.data.ts)

[compareExistentialistAndAnalyticApproachesToAProblem.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/historyAndTraditionsOfPhilosophy/schoolsAndMovements/skills/compareExistentialistAndAnalyticApproachesToAProblem.data.ts)

### Logik dan Penghujahan

Groups: 6 · Skills: 35

[logicAndArgumentation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/logicAndArgumentation.data.ts)

[argumentativeFallacies.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/argumentativeFallacies/argumentativeFallacies.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A flaw concerns the relation between claims and reasons, not necessarily the speaker's motives or a named cognitive bias. Context matters: surface wording alone rarely proves fallaciousness.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Belajar mengenal pasti kelemahan biasa dalam alasan yang menyokong sesuatu dakwaan.

**Methodological description (English):** Identify a purported exhaustive choice that overlooks meaningful alternatives or combined possibilities.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Cari pilihan lain yang bermakna di sebalik pilihan palsu seolah-olah hanya dua kemungkinan.

[detectAStrawManArgument.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/argumentativeFallacies/skills/detectAStrawManArgument.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Show where a position is distorted into an easier target and recover the actual view before evaluating it.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Perhatikan apabila pendirian seseorang diputarbelitkan supaya lebih mudah diserang.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Kenal pasti apabila serangan peribadi menggantikan alasan yang berkaitan.

[detectAnEquivocationFallacy.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/argumentativeFallacies/skills/detectAnEquivocationFallacy.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Trace a shift between meanings of the same expression that makes an inference appear stronger than it is.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Kenal pasti apabila makna sesuatu perkataan berubah dalam satu hujah.

[detectCircularReasoning.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/argumentativeFallacies/skills/detectCircularReasoning.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize when the offered support presupposes the very claim at issue without independent justification.

[evaluateAnAppealToAuthority.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/argumentativeFallacies/skills/evaluateAnAppealToAuthority.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine whether expertise is relevant and reliable evidence in context, rather than assuming that invoking any authority proves a conclusion.

**Methodological description (English):** Reject the antecedent of a conditional from the denial of its consequent, under the conditional as stated.

[assessDeductiveValidity.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/deductiveReasoning/skills/assessDeductiveValidity.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine whether a conclusion must hold if the premises hold, using logical structure rather than agreement with the conclusion.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Semak sama ada semua premis boleh benar tetapi kesimpulannya salah.

[distinguishValidityFromSoundness.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/deductiveReasoning/skills/distinguishValidityFromSoundness.data.ts)

[analyzeAPhilosophicalProblemOfArtificialConsciousness.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/mindSelfAndHumanExistence/mindAndConsciousness/skills/analyzeAPhilosophicalProblemOfArtificialConsciousness.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess what would and would not count as evidence of experience in an artificial system, without claiming a settled test exists.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Pertimbangkan bukti yang boleh menyokong dakwaan tentang kesedaran buatan.

##### Membandingkan teori hubungan minda-badan

[compareTheoriesOfTheMindBodyRelation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/mindSelfAndHumanExistence/mindAndConsciousness/skills/compareTheoriesOfTheMindBodyRelation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Contrast representative views such as physicalism and dualism by their commitments and explanatory challenges.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Bandingkan penjelasan falsafah tentang hubungan minda dan badan.

##### Membezakan huraian mental dan fizikal

[distinguishMentalFromPhysicalDescriptions.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/mindSelfAndHumanExistence/mindAndConsciousness/skills/distinguishMentalFromPhysicalDescriptions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify when a claim describes subjective experience, observable behavior, or bodily processes, and why they are not automatically equivalent.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Bezakan huraian perasaan dengan huraian proses fizikal dalam otak.

##### Menjelaskan masalah minda orang lain

[explainTheProblemOfOtherMinds.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/mindSelfAndHumanExistence/mindAndConsciousness/skills/explainTheProblemOfOtherMinds.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Describe why another being's subjective experiences are not observed in the same way as one's own, and what kinds of inferences are used.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Tanya bagaimana kita boleh mengetahui sama ada makhluk lain mempunyai pengalaman subjektif.

#### Identiti peribadi

Skills: 4

[personalIdentity.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/mindSelfAndHumanExistence/personalIdentity/personalIdentity.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** The self may be characterized by bodily, psychological, narrative, or relational continuity. The question is what makes someone the same person, not how memory works empirically.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Terokai perkara yang menjadikan seseorang masih orang yang sama walaupun berubah mengikut masa.

##### Menganalisis kriteria status sebagai insan

[analyzeAPersonhoodCriterion.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/mindSelfAndHumanExistence/personalIdentity/skills/analyzeAPersonhoodCriterion.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Test a proposed condition of being a person against borderline cases without assigning anyone lesser real-world dignity.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Uji kriteria status sebagai insan dengan kes sukar tanpa menafikan maruah manusia.

##### Membandingkan teori kesinambungan jasmani dan psikologi

[compareBodilyAndPsychologicalContinuityAccounts.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/mindSelfAndHumanExistence/personalIdentity/skills/compareBodilyAndPsychologicalContinuityAccounts.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess how different criteria handle change, memory loss, and hypothetical transfer scenarios.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Bandingkan konsep identiti peribadi berasaskan badan dan psikologi.

[distinguishPersonalIdentityFromSimilarity.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/mindSelfAndHumanExistence/personalIdentity/skills/distinguishPersonalIdentityFromSimilarity.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain why sharing a personality or appearance is not enough to establish that two persons are numerically identical.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Fahami mengapa dua orang yang serupa tidak semestinya individu yang sama.

##### Menilai peranan ingatan dalam identiti peribadi

[evaluateTheRoleOfMemoryInPersonalIdentity.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/mindSelfAndHumanExistence/personalIdentity/skills/evaluateTheRoleOfMemoryInPersonalIdentity.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine the philosophical significance and limitations of remembered experience as a criterion of persistence.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Teliti sama ada ingatan cukup untuk menentukan kesinambungan seseorang.

### Penyelidikan Falsafah

Groups: 3 · Skills: 12

[philosophicalInquiry.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophicalInquiry/philosophicalInquiry.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Philosophy investigates conceptual, normative, and foundational questions whose answers require reasons rather than observation alone. This domain concerns the practices used to formulate, refine, and discuss such questions; it is distinct from the formal evaluation of arguments in Logic.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Terokai soalan tentang makna, nilai dan andaian melalui perbincangan beralasan.

#### Analisis Konseptual

Skills: 4

[conceptualAnalysis.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophicalInquiry/conceptualAnalysis/conceptualAnalysis.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Careful discussion depends on tracking the boundaries of concepts, especially when ordinary words cover multiple cases. These abilities refine meanings rather than merely memorize technical vocabulary.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Terokai bagaimana takrif yang jelas dan contoh yang sesuai meningkatkan pemikiran falsafah.

##### Menjelaskan Konsep yang Dipertikaikan

[clarifyAContestedConcept.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophicalInquiry/conceptualAnalysis/skills/clarifyAContestedConcept.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Specify relevant conditions or uses of a term such as freedom so interlocutors can determine what their disagreement concerns.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Jelaskan makna sesuatu istilah apabila orang tidak sependapat tentang penggunaannya.

##### Membezakan Syarat Perlu dan Syarat Mencukupi

[distinguishNecessaryFromSufficientConditions.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophicalInquiry/conceptualAnalysis/skills/distinguishNecessaryFromSufficientConditions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine whether a proposed property is required for a concept to apply, enough for it to apply, or both; a condition can fail one test and pass the other.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Tentukan sama ada sesuatu syarat itu perlu, mencukupi, kedua-duanya atau bukan kedua-duanya.

##### Menguji Takrif dengan Contoh Penyangkal

[testADefinitionWithACounterexample.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophicalInquiry/conceptualAnalysis/skills/testADefinitionWithACounterexample.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Find a case included or excluded incorrectly by a proposed definition and explain what the case reveals about its limits.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Cabar takrif dengan mencari keadaan yang dikelaskannya secara salah.

##### Meneliti Konsep melalui Eksperimen Pemikiran

[useAThoughtExperimentToExamineAConcept.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophicalInquiry/conceptualAnalysis/skills/useAThoughtExperimentToExamineAConcept.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Vary features of an imagined situation to isolate a philosophical principle; make clear which assumptions are stipulated rather than observed.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Gunakan situasi khayalan untuk menguji idea sambil menjelaskan andaian yang dibuat.

#### Dialog dan Perbezaan Pendapat

Skills: 4

[dialogueAndDisagreement.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophicalInquiry/dialogueAndDisagreement/dialogueAndDisagreement.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Reasoned dialogue seeks understanding and justified revision, not simply winning assent. Participants must fairly represent alternatives and keep interpersonal respect separate from agreement.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Ketahui bagaimana perbezaan pendapat secara hormat membantu kita menilai semula idea.

##### Mengemukakan Soalan Falsafah yang Mendalam

[askAProbingPhilosophicalQuestion.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophicalInquiry/dialogueAndDisagreement/skills/askAProbingPhilosophicalQuestion.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Request a reason, distinction, implication, or counterexample that can advance inquiry without demanding personal disclosure.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Tanya soalan yang menguji alasan seseorang atau menjelaskan pandangannya.

##### Menyusun Semula Pendirian Orang Lain Secara Adil

[reconstructAnotherPersonsPositionFairly.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophicalInquiry/dialogueAndDisagreement/skills/reconstructAnotherPersonsPositionFairly.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Restate an interlocutor's strongest contextually plausible position accurately and charitably, rather than attacking a weaker caricature; fair reconstruction does not require overlooking genuine contradictions or unsupported claims.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Nyatakan semula pendirian orang lain dengan tepat sebelum mengkritiknya.

##### Menjawab Bantahan Falsafah

[respondToAPhilosophicalObjection.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophicalInquiry/dialogueAndDisagreement/skills/respondToAPhilosophicalObjection.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Address the actual challenge to a claim, rather than diverting to the objector's identity or motives.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Jawab isi bantahan dan bukannya menyerang orang yang mengemukakannya.

##### Menyemak Pendirian Berdasarkan Alasan

[reviseAPositionInLightOfReasons.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophicalInquiry/dialogueAndDisagreement/skills/reviseAPositionInLightOfReasons.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify which premise or conclusion should change when a cogent objection defeats an earlier commitment.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Ubah kepercayaan atau hujah apabila alasan lebih kukuh menunjukkan ia perlu disemak.

#### Soalan dan Masalah

Skills: 4

**Methodological description (English):** A productive philosophical problem can be examined through competing answers, explicit concepts, and reasons. The object is to make a question discussable without assuming that every question has a single empirical test.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Belajar menukar idea yang mengelirukan menjadi soalan yang boleh dibincangkan dengan teliti.

##### Membezakan Masalah Falsafah daripada Contoh

[distinguishAPhilosophicalProblemFromAnExample.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophicalInquiry/questionsAndProblems/skills/distinguishAPhilosophicalProblemFromAnExample.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Separate the general issue, such as whether promises create obligations, from the particular story used to make it vivid.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Bezakan persoalan falsafah umum daripada cerita yang menggambarkannya.

##### Membezakan Soalan Falsafah dan Empirik

[distinguishPhilosophicalQuestionsFromEmpiricalQuestions.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophicalInquiry/questionsAndProblems/skills/distinguishPhilosophicalQuestionsFromEmpiricalQuestions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify when an issue asks what a concept means, what ought to be done, or what ultimately explains something, rather than only requesting a measurable fact; many questions have both aspects.

##### Merumuskan Soalan Falsafah

[formulateAPhilosophicalQuestion.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophicalInquiry/questionsAndProblems/skills/formulateAPhilosophicalQuestion.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Turn an ordinary puzzlement into an open question about meaning, reasons, values, or assumptions that admits more than a yes-or-no preference.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Ajukan soalan terbuka tentang alasan, makna atau nilai, bukan sekadar pilihan peribadi.

##### Mengenal Pasti Andaian dalam Masalah Falsafah

[identifyAssumptionsInAPhilosophicalProblem.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophicalInquiry/questionsAndProblems/skills/identifyAssumptionsInAPhilosophicalProblem.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Expose propositions that a question or proposed answer takes for granted, such as what counts as a person or what makes an action fair.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Cari andaian tersembunyi di sebalik soalan falsafah atau jawapan yang dicadangkan.

[distinguishDescriptiveFromEvaluativeLanguage.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfLanguage/languageTruthAndPower/skills/distinguishDescriptiveFromEvaluativeLanguage.data.ts)

[evaluateAClaimAboutLinguisticRepresentation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfLanguage/languageTruthAndPower/skills/evaluateAClaimAboutLinguisticRepresentation.data.ts)

[meaningAndReference.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfLanguage/meaningAndReference/meaningAndReference.data.ts)

[identifySemanticAmbiguity.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfLanguage/meaningAndReference/skills/identifySemanticAmbiguity.data.ts)

[philosophyOfReligion.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfReligion/philosophyOfReligion.data.ts)

**User-friendly description (ms):** Belajar membincangkan perbezaan agama, ketidakpercayaan dan makna hidup dengan penuh hormat.

[analyzeReligiousPluralismAsAPhilosophicalProblem.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfReligion/diversityAndMeaning/skills/analyzeReligiousPluralismAsAPhilosophicalProblem.data.ts)

[analyzeReligiousToleranceAsAnEthicalPrinciple.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfReligion/diversityAndMeaning/skills/analyzeReligiousToleranceAsAnEthicalPrinciple.data.ts)

[distinguishReligiousSkepticismFromAgnosticism.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfReligion/diversityAndMeaning/skills/distinguishReligiousSkepticismFromAgnosticism.data.ts)

[faithReasonAndExperience.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfReligion/faithReasonAndExperience/faithReasonAndExperience.data.ts)

**User-friendly description (ms):** Pelajari cara kepercayaan, penaakulan dan pengalaman digunakan untuk mewajarkan dakwaan agama.

[compareFaithAndReasonAsSourcesOfJustification.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfReligion/faithReasonAndExperience/skills/compareFaithAndReasonAsSourcesOfJustification.data.ts)

[distinguishPhilosophicalInquiryFromReligiousPractice.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfReligion/faithReasonAndExperience/skills/distinguishPhilosophicalInquiryFromReligiousPractice.data.ts)

[evaluateReligiousExperienceAsEvidence.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfReligion/faithReasonAndExperience/skills/evaluateReligiousExperienceAsEvidence.data.ts)

[comparePhilosophicalConceptionsOfDivinity.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfReligion/ultimateRealityAndDivinity/skills/comparePhilosophicalConceptionsOfDivinity.data.ts)

[evaluateAProposedUltimateExplanation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfReligion/ultimateRealityAndDivinity/skills/evaluateAProposedUltimateExplanation.data.ts)

[reconstructAPhilosophicalArgumentAboutDivinity.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfReligion/ultimateRealityAndDivinity/skills/reconstructAPhilosophicalArgumentAboutDivinity.data.ts)

### Falsafah sains

Groups: 4 · Skills: 26

[philosophyOfScience.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/philosophyOfScience.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Scientific inquiry is examined as a way of building, testing, and revising explanations. The focus is on general methodology and evidential justification; physics, biology, psychology, and other sciences own their domain-specific investigations.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Terokai cara dakwaan saintifik diuji, disokong, disemak dan dipersoalkan.

#### Bukti dan inferens sebab-akibat

Skills: 6

**User-friendly description (ms):** Terokai apa yang bukti boleh dan tidak boleh buktikan tentang hubungan sebab-akibat.

[assessMeasurementValidity.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/evidenceAndCausalInference/skills/assessMeasurementValidity.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine whether an operational measure genuinely captures the construct a researcher claims to study.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Semak sama ada sesuatu ukuran benar-benar mengukur perkara yang didakwa diukurnya.

[assessSampleRepresentativeness.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/evidenceAndCausalInference/skills/assessSampleRepresentativeness.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine whether selection and coverage allow findings to extend to the population named in a conclusion.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Tentukan sama ada peserta terpilih mewakili populasi yang lebih luas.

**Methodological description (English):** Explain why two variables varying together does not alone show that changing one produces the other.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Dua pemboleh ubah berubah bersama tidak semestinya bermakna satu menyebabkan yang lain.

[evaluateACausalConclusionFromAStudy.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/evidenceAndCausalInference/skills/evaluateACausalConclusionFromAStudy.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Judge how design, alternative explanations, limitations, and observed evidence jointly support or weaken a causal claim.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Nilai dakwaan sebab-akibat dengan meneliti reka bentuk, bukti dan penjelasan lain.

[identifyAConfoundingFactor.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/evidenceAndCausalInference/skills/identifyAConfoundingFactor.data.ts)

**User-friendly description (ms):** Cari faktor ketiga yang mungkin menjelaskan hubungan yang kelihatan.

#### Reka bentuk eksperimen

Skills: 9

[experimentalDesign.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/experimentalDesign/experimentalDesign.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Controlled investigations attempt to isolate explanatory factors while managing confounding, expectations, and ethical constraints. Particular safeguards solve different problems and are not interchangeable.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Ketahui cara reka bentuk penyelidikan menjadikan perbandingan lebih boleh dipercayai.

##### Mengawal keadaan eksperimen yang berkaitan

[controlRelevantExperimentalConditions.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/experimentalDesign/skills/controlRelevantExperimentalConditions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Hold relevant background conditions stable or account for them so comparisons are not undermined by extraneous differences.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Pastikan keadaan latar penting kekal sama untuk perbandingan yang adil.

[evaluateResearchEthics.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/experimentalDesign/skills/evaluateResearchEthics.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess informed consent, voluntary participation, proportionality of risk, participant protection, and integrity of reporting in proposed research; distinguish ethical permissibility from whether a study can yield valid data.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Pertimbangkan persetujuan, keselamatan dan pelaporan yang jujur apabila menilai kajian dicadangkan.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Terokai bagaimana peserta dan penyelidik yang tidak mengetahui pengagihan boleh mengurangkan bias tertentu.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Terangkan cara pengagihan kumpulan secara rawak boleh mengurangkan perbezaan sedia ada.

**Methodological description (English):** Identify which party is kept unaware of assigned conditions and how that may reduce particular expectation-related effects.

**Methodological description (English):** Identify the comparison condition needed to interpret an intervention's effect where a control group is appropriate.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Fahami bagaimana kumpulan kawalan membantu mengasingkan kesan intervensi.

[questionsAndHypotheses.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/questionsAndHypotheses/questionsAndHypotheses.data.ts)

[socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy.data.ts)

[distinguishPublicReasonsFromPrivatePreferences.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/publicReasonAndCivicLife/skills/distinguishPublicReasonsFromPrivatePreferences.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify justifications aimed at principles others can evaluate, rather than asserting that a personal desire must settle collective policy.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Bezakan alasan umum daripada kecenderungan peribadi yang tidak semestinya dikongsi orang lain.

##### Menilai pandangan kewajipan politik

[evaluateCompetingViewsOfPoliticalObligation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/publicReasonAndCivicLife/skills/evaluateCompetingViewsOfPoliticalObligation.data.ts)

#### Hak dan Kebebasan

Skills: 4

[rightsAndLiberty.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/rightsAndLiberty/rightsAndLiberty.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A right may protect a person's action, claim, or status and create obligations for others. Competing rights can require principled reconciliation.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Terokai apa yang boleh dituntut sebagai hak dan maksud kebebasan.

##### Menganalisis konflik antara hak

[analyzeAConflictBetweenRights.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/rightsAndLiberty/skills/analyzeAConflictBetweenRights.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify whose claims compete and evaluate justified limits without assuming one right automatically cancels all others.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Pertimbangkan cara menyelesaikan pertentangan antara hak yang penting.

##### Membezakan kebebasan negatif dan positif

[distinguishNegativeAndPositiveLiberty.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/rightsAndLiberty/skills/distinguishNegativeAndPositiveLiberty.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Contrast freedom from interference with capacities or opportunities to act, while recognizing debates about their relationship.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Bandingkan kebebasan daripada gangguan dengan keupayaan bertindak secara berkesan.

##### Membezakan hak dan keistimewaan

[distinguishRightsFromPrivileges.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/rightsAndLiberty/skills/distinguishRightsFromPrivileges.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify whether a claim concerns an entitlement owed to a person or an advantage conditional on discretionary permission.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Bezakan tuntutan yang menjadi hak seseorang daripada keistimewaan bersyarat.

##### Menjelaskan kebebasan hati nurani

[explainFreedomOfConscience.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/rightsAndLiberty/skills/explainFreedomOfConscience.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess why protecting personal belief and nonbelief may matter independently of agreement with any particular worldview.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Terokai mengapa orang harus bebas memiliki pegangan agama atau bukan agama.

#### Teknologi dan Masyarakat

Skills: 3

[technologyAndSociety.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/technologyAndSociety/technologyAndSociety.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Technological artifacts and institutions shape the practical conditions of action, social change, and control. Philosophical analysis evaluates these mediation and agency claims rather than measuring product usage or engineering device performance.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Belajar menganalisis bagaimana teknologi mempengaruhi tindakan manusia dan masyarakat.

##### Menganalisis autonomi manusia dalam sistem teknologi

[analyzeHumanAutonomyInTechnologicalSystems.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/technologyAndSociety/skills/analyzeHumanAutonomyInTechnologicalSystems.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate when reliance on automated or networked systems enhances or constrains meaningful choice and control, separate from the narrower ethics of individual algorithmic decisions.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Terokai bila teknologi menambah atau mengurangkan kawalan seseorang ke atas keputusannya.

##### Menganalisis pengantaraan teknologi

[analyzeTechnologicalMediation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/technologyAndSociety/skills/analyzeTechnologicalMediation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine how a technological artifact changes the available actions, relationships, or choices through which people engage the world, without reducing the issue to the device's technical operation.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Teliti bagaimana teknologi mengubah pilihan dan hubungan yang tersedia kepada manusia.

##### Menilai determinisme teknologi

[evaluateTechnologicalDeterminism.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/technologyAndSociety/skills/evaluateTechnologicalDeterminism.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess arguments that technological development determines social arrangements, including objections based on political choice, design, and historical contingency.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Persoalkan sama ada perubahan teknologi sahaja menentukan perkembangan masyarakat.
